Exercise D – Choose the Correct Answer (1 mark each)
Choose the correct answer.
  • 28. 'Why were you so tired yesterday?' 'Because I ……… all morning.'
    ✓ C – had been jogging (past perfect continuous)
  • 29. It was the first time I ……… a live match.
    ✓ C – had ever seen (first time + past perfect)
  • 30. 'You live in a huge house, don't you?' 'Yes, but we ……… !'
    ✓ A – didn't use to (past habit no longer true)
  • 31. I ……… the whole of War and Peace by the time I was seven years old.
    ✓ C – had read (completed action before a past point)
  • 32. Karate hurt my hands at first, but I finally ……… it in the end.
    ✓ A – got used to (became accustomed to)
  • 33. I ……… for the match to begin when suddenly a dog ran onto the pitch.
    ✓ C – was waiting (past continuous interrupted by event)
  • 34. Before she retired, my grandma …… go for a run every morning before work.
    ✓ B – would (past habitual action)
